title: South Korean PE firm MBK Partners agrees to take Japan's Wacom private, in a deal valuing the digital pen tech company at ~$860M, with Samsung participating
html:
This is a Techmeme archive page. It shows how the site appeared at 11:45 PM ET, November 22, 2026.

The most current version of the site as always is available at our home page. To view an earlier snapshot click here and then modify the date indicated.
summary: The South Korean private-equity firm agreed to buy the Japanese digital-pen maker.
